auto_context.card: This is an archived gaming live stream uploaded on September 2, 2025, from Polka Ch. 尾丸ポルカ (Omaru Polka), a Japanese VTuber belonging to hololive Production's hololive Gamers unit. Polka is playing 8番出口 (Hachi-ban Deguchi / The Exit 8), a Japanese indie walking-simulator horror game set in an underground subway passage where the player must spot anomalies and turn back when they find one, or keep walking when everything looks normal. The title mentions that new anomalies have been added to the game and references a theatrical film release (劇場版公開), suggesting this session revisits the game after a content update tied to a movie tie-in. The tone is casual and energetic, typical of a live variety-style gaming stream aimed at a general Japanese-speaking audience.
